name: Order type select
description: Delivery, collection or dine-in, from a dropdown.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/fulfilment-select", name: "Order type select", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Delivery, collection or dine-in, from a dropdown.",
  states: [StringState(name: "orderType", default: "delivery")],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    SelectField(state: "orderType", label: "Order type", options: [SelectOption(value: "delivery", label: "Delivery"), SelectOption(value: "collection", label: "Collection"), SelectOption(value: "dine-in", label: "Dine in")])
  )],
)
